home.title: Expected End | Kusudi, lililojengwa kwa uzuri
home.description: Expected End huunda programu zenye kufikiriwa vizuri, zana za tija, uzoefu wa kidijitali, na jumuiya.

about.title: Kuhusu | Expected End
about.description: Hadithi ya mwanzilishi Denzel Rigaud, dhamira ya Expected End, na miradi iliyojengwa kwa imani na kusudi.

denzel-rigaud.title: Denzel Rigaud | Mwanzilishi wa Expected End
denzel-rigaud.description: Denzel Rigaud ni mwanzilishi na msanidi programu wa full-stack aliye nyuma ya Expected End, MyBibleLens, Programu ya Patakatifu pa Ukristo, na The Water Check.

press.title: Vyombo vya Habari | Expected End
press.description: Wasifu ulioidhinishwa, ukweli uliothibitishwa, viungo rasmi, na picha na video za kupakua kwa ajili ya habari kuhusu Expected End na Denzel Rigaud.

terms.title: Masharti ya Matumizi ya Tovuti | Expected End
terms.description: Masharti yanayosimamia matumizi ya tovuti ya Expected End.

privacy.title: Taarifa ya Faragha | Expected End
privacy.description: Jinsi Expected End inavyoshughulikia taarifa kwenye tovuti hii.

watercheck-privacy.title: Sera ya Faragha ya The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-privacy.description: Kile The Water Check inachokusanya, kinachobaki kwenye simu yako, wanaosaidia kuendesha programu, na chaguo zako.

watercheck-terms.title: Sheria na Masharti ya The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-terms.description: Masharti ya kutumia programu ya The Water Check, ikiwemo afya na usalama, AI, kanuni za Vikundi na ununuzi.

watercheck-health-data.title: Sera ya Faragha ya Data ya Afya ya Watumiaji ya The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-health-data.description: Jinsi The Water Check inavyoshughulikia data ya afya ya watumiaji, na jinsi ya kuifikia, kuifuta au kukata rufaa.

watercheck-delete-account.title: Futa akaunti yako | The Water Check
watercheck-delete-account.description: Jinsi ya kufuta akaunti yako ya The Water Check na data yako, kwenye programu au kwa barua pepe.

watercheck-community.title: Miongozo ya Jumuiya | The Water Check
watercheck-community.description: Jinsi Vikundi katika The Water Check vinavyobaki vya kirafiki: kanuni, kuripoti na kuzuia, na kinachotokea kanuni zinapovunjwa.

accessibility.title: Ufikivu | Expected End
accessibility.description: Ahadi ya Expected End ya kutoa tovuti inayofikika kwa kila mtu.

mybiblelens-store.title: Duka la MyBibleLens | Expected End
mybiblelens-store.description: Bidhaa zenye maana kwa ajili ya kutembea karibu zaidi na Neno. Duka la MyBibleLens linakuja hivi karibuni.

watercheck-store.title: Duka la The Water Check | Expected End
watercheck-store.description: Bidhaa muhimu zilizochochewa na unywaji maji kutoka The Water Check. Toleo la kwanza linakuja hivi karibuni.

watercheck-page.title: The Water Check | Programu ya Unywaji Maji na Kikokotoo cha Bure
watercheck-page.description: Gundua programu ya The Water Check na ujaribu makadirio ya bure na ya faragha ya maji unayohitaji, kwenye Expected End.

watercheck-calculator.title: Kikokotoo cha Maji cha Bure | The Water Check
watercheck-calculator.description: Pata makadirio ya bure na ya faragha ya maji unayohitaji kila siku kwa kikokotoo cha The Water Check.

not-found.title: Ukurasa haukupatikana | Expected End
not-found.description: Ukurasa wa Expected End ulioombwa haukupatikana.
